name: ocbc-climate-collateral
description: OCBC climate risk platform with collateral decision tool. Synthetic portfolio, illustrative figures.

comments.db-driver: The app and the tests always speak the Postgres wire protocol through `pg` and DATABASE_URL. Locally that server is PGlite with the real PostGIS extension (npm run db:up); under docker compose it is postgis/postgis:16-3.4. Nothing above the driver changes.
comments.harness-deps-go-here: worker-b (S4) adds the test harnesses to devDependencies: vitest, @vitest/browser or jsdom, @testing-library/react, @testing-library/jest-dom, @playwright/test. Keep them in devDependencies and leave the four test:* scripts above as they are.
comments.auth-deps-go-here: worker-b (S3) adds bcryptjs (+ @types/bcryptjs) and iron-session to dependencies.
comments.map-deps-go-here: worker-c (S16, S23) adds maplibre-gl, pmtiles and protomaps-themes-base to dependencies.
comments.llm-deps-go-here: worker-b (S22, S25) adds @anthropic-ai/sdk to dependencies on Day 4.
